course_position.stage_name: Consolidation, Fluency, Confidence, and Integrated Review

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Compare conversational Swedish with a clearer semi-formal written message.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A housing or service issue needs to be discussed aloud and then written briefly.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Reformulating spoken explanation into a concise, polite message.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss a problem with noise, access, or a small repair, then decide how to phrase a short message to a landlord or service contact.

main_focus.name: spoken-to-written reformulation with clear polite phrasing
main_focus.description: Transform a conversational explanation into a brief semi-formal message with clear reason and request.
model_examples: Det låter mycket i trapphuset på kvällarna.
Jag skulle vilja be er kontrollera ljudet i trapphuset efter klockan 22.
main_focus.desired_presence: Include 2-3 spoken phrasings and 2-3 more written or semi-formal reformulations.

allowed_supporting_grammar: subordinate clauses with eftersom and när

vocabulary_target.theme: semi-formal message about a housing or service problem
useful_chunks: När jag pratar låter det så här...
I ett meddelande kan man skriva...
Jag skulle vilja be er att...
Vänligen återkom när ni har möjlighet.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use the same core problem in both spoken and semi-formal wording.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker explains the problem in everyday spoken Swedish.
dialogue_shape.middle: They discuss which details belong in a short written message and reformulate the request politely.
dialogue_shape.ending: They choose a final message focus and remove unnecessary details.

target_complexity.repetition: contrast spoken and written versions without creating a full letter

focus: the practical problem that needs to be reported
the difference between the spoken explanation and the written message
the main request in the final message

sentence_focus: one spoken sentence explaining the problem simply
one semi-formal sentence with Jag skulle vilja be er att
one concise sentence asking for follow-up
